newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cuts excise duty on bank loans.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cuts excise duty on bank loans.

text.p: Pakistani Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz said on Friday he had reduced excise duty on bank loans in his budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June).
Aziz told Reuters Financial Television in an interview just ahead of his budget speech to parliament that the unspecified cut would bring interest rates down by 1.7 percent.

He said the average interest rate was 17.5 percent, but that included concessionary export financing at 13 percent. Most industrial and commercial borrowers were paying 20 to 22 percent, at least eight percent higher than the inflation rate.
"As a matter of policy we do wish to bring down the interest rate to say, inflation plus two or three percent," he said.
